title: REQ · Phaser reads shared GameState from a Zustand store without duplicating it
summary: GameState moves into a Zustand store that useGame and a Phaser scene both use.
description: Context: useGame.ts holds GameState in useState, which Phaser cannot read. Desired behavior: add src/store/gameStore.ts exporting useGameStore with state: GameState|null and setState(updater). useGame reads and writes this store while keeping its return shape and localStorage persistence. Add src/phaser/BootScene.ts, a Phaser.Scene that reads useGameStore.getState().state on demand, subscribes to store changes and emits sceneReady, without keeping its own copy. Expected result: one owner of state. Why: avoids duplicated state ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Given the store is set to a GameState, When BootScene.readState() runs, Then it returns the store's object by reference.
Given the store changes, When the BootScene subscription fires, Then the scene reads the new state and holds no cached copy.
Given useGame renders, When act is called, Then the store state updates and the return shape is unchanged.
Given BootScene shuts down, When shutdown runs, Then the store subscription is removed.
definition_of_done: useGame uses the store and existing tests still pass
